stage1.impression: A dark glossy slab with a ribbed fan-shaped mirror set into it, in front of a large pale panel lit by a hard theatrical spotlight oval that repeats on the floor; the mirror is split down the middle into a white half and a black half, and nothing reads as clear acrylic. It looks like a competent technical render of a dark box, not a collectible, and the cropped pale panel dominates the top two thirds.

blocking_9: The shard reads as a mirror across its whole width: no half of it below lum 100 (now x 1000-1200 at 25 against 223 on the left).
No hard-edged spot oval on the sleeve or floor: the sleeve above the stand within 25 levels of its surround (now 156 against 81).
The black sleeve reads black and neutral, darker than the acrylic (now median 70, warm r75/b63, brighter than the block at 47).
The smoke-grey base stratum shows tone and its polished face, not a pure-black band (now median 1, 91% crushed).
The acrylic reads clear: bright polished edges and end faces from the rims (end face now median 51, p95 59).
The composition shows the object as a whole, or crops the sleeve deliberately: now the sleeve runs off the top and fills two thirds of the frame while the stand sits in the lower half.

changes.problem: The mirror shard reflects the front softbox only on its left half; the right half reflects the dark set and reads as a black hole, so it does not read as a mirror of grooves.
changes.expected: The softbox's reflection spans the whole curved sector; the right half of the shard rises from about 25 to 130-200, with the grooves visible as fine bright/dark lines across all of it.

changes.problem: The glint spot throws a hard-edged oval on the sleeve above the stand and a second oval on the floor in front, a stage-spot look that pulls the eye off the shard and gives no glint on it.

evidence.measured: median 156 against 81 on the sleeve at [200,380,500,480]; the floor oval [700,920,1300,980] median 76 against 43-57 elsewhere on the floor

changes.expected: The oval on the sleeve falls to within about 20 levels of the surrounding sleeve; the spot remains as a small specular glint on the stand's edges and shard only.

changes.problem: The sleeve is meant to be black but reads as a warm mid-grey brighter than the acrylic, so the tonal hierarchy is inverted and the frame's top two thirds is a flat beige card.

evidence.measured: median 69.8, r75 g69 b63, range 37; block front [150,550,700,680] median 47

change.to: a matte black flag 500 x 400 mm between the key and the sleeve, its lower edge at z 110 (just above the stand's top at 72 plus the slot), at about (-330, -250, 300), facing the key, so it cuts the key off the sleeve above the stand but leaves the key on the acrylic

changes.expected: The sleeve falls to a neutral near-black 30-50 with a soft gradient from the rims at its edges, darker than the lit acrylic.

changes.problem: The smoke-grey base stratum is a pure-black band with no tone or reflection, so the base reads as a hole, not polished smoked acrylic.

change.to: a matte white card 700 x 60 mm lying almost flat on the floor at (0, -260, 2), tilted 15 degrees toward the stand, lit only by the existing key and front, placed out of frame below the bottom edge, so the stratum's polished front face reflects it

changes.expected: The base stratum shows a dark grey reflection band 20-45 with a visible top and bottom edge, still the darkest part of the object.

changes.problem: The right end face and top edges of the acrylic show no bright polished-edge light, so the block reads as dark glass rather than clear cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: end face median 51, p95 59; top edge [150,515,1500,545] median 33

changes.expected: A bright vertical edge line and lifted end face on the right end, p95 rising to 100-200 without clipping, separating the stand from the cove.

changes.problem: The left end of the stand merges into the floor and the sleeve edge, with no rim separating the acrylic's left end.

evidence.measured: median 30, range 4.3: a flat dark patch with no edge light

changes.expected: The left end face of the block picks up a polished edge line, p95 rising to 80-180.

out_of_scope.request: Pull the camera back or shorten the lens so the whole sleeve and stand sit in frame with air above.
out_of_scope.why: Not fixed, but a camera move invalidates every region test above; do it in the next round once the light is settled. Now the sleeve runs off the top and the stand is cut to the lower half, which undercuts a hero.

out_of_scope.request: Make the acrylic body read clearer (less dark through the front face).
out_of_scope.why: The optics and tint are fixed; the front face is dark largely because it transmits the black sleeve and dark cove behind it. Only light (c5, c6) can address it.
